scoring_justification: Peak positions, widths, and magnetization values are recomputed from the agent's raw CSV to verify the claimed AHM-XXZ mapping, peak ordering, and low-temperature behaviour.

outputs.description: Computed specific heat and magnetization curves for the AHM (symmetric and asymmetric) and the effective XXZ model at half-filling.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker will evaluate the computed thermodynamic data against reference values. The scoring function is not disclosed.

steps.description: Peak position match between AHM_asym and XXZ_asym (|ΔT_peak| ≤ 0.05 t↓)
Symmetric AHM peak at higher temperature than asymmetric AHM peak
Symmetric AHM peak broader (larger FWHM) than asymmetric AHM peak
Magnetization |M| < 0.1 at T = 0.05, 0.10, 0.15 for both AHM models
